papers.title: Inferencing the earth moving equipment-environment interaction in open pit mining
papers.abstract: In mining, grade control generally focuses on blast hole sampling and the estimation of ore control block models with little or no attention given to how the materials are being excavated from the ground. In the process of loading trucks, the underlying variability of the individual bucket load will determine the variability of truck payload. Hence, accurate material movement demands a good knowledge of the excavation process and the buckets interaction with the environment. However, equipment frequently goes into off nominal states due to unexpected delays, disturbances or faults. The large amount of such disturbances causes information loss that reduces the statistical power and biases estimates, leading to increased uncertainty in the production. A reliable method that inferences the missing knowledge about the interaction between the machine and the environment from the available data sources, is vital to accurately model the material movement. In this study, a twostep method was implemented that performed unsupervised clustering and then predicted the missing information. The first method is DBSCAN based spatial clustering which divides the diggers and buckets positional data into connected loading segments. Clear patterns of segmented bucket dig positions were observed. The second model utilized Gaussian process regression which was trained with the clustered data and the model was then used to infer the mean locations of the test clusters. Bucket dig locations were then simulated at the inferred mean locations for different durations and compared against the known bucket dig locations. This method was tested at an open pit mine in the Pilbara of Western Australia. The results demonstrate the advantage of the proposed method in inferencing the missing information of bucket environment interactions and therefore enables miners to continuously track the material movement.

summary_zh.motivation: 推断采矿中铲斗与环境相互作用的缺失信息，以实现精确物料追踪。
summary_zh.method: 使用DBSCAN空间聚类和GP回归推断缺失的铲斗挖掘位置。
summary_zh.result: 方法成功推断缺失位置，实现连续物料追踪。
summary_zh.validation: 在澳大利亚Pilbara露天矿进行了现场测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To infer missing information about bucket-environment interactions in open pit mining for accurate material tracking.
summary_en.method: A two-step method using DBSCAN spatial clustering followed by Gaussian process regression to predict missing bucket dig locations.
summary_en.result: The proposed method successfully inferred missing bucket dig locations, enabling continuous material movement tracking.
summary_en.validation: The method was validated with field data from an open pit mine in the Pilbara, Western Australia.

papers.title: A neural operator-based surrogate solver for free-form electromagnetic inverse design
papers.abstract: Neural operators have emerged as a powerful tool for solving partial differential equations in the context of scientific machine learning. Here, we implement and train a modified Fourier neural operator as a surrogate solver for electromagnetic scattering problems and compare its data efficiency to existing methods. We further demonstrate its application to the gradient-based nanophotonic inverse design of free-form, fully three-dimensional electromagnetic scatterers, an area that has so far eluded the application of deep learning techniques.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移到生物力学代理模型，但本文仅验证于电磁散射，未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis or surrogate modeling for biomechanical implant design; it focuses on electromagnetic wave scattering for nanophotonics without any validation on biomedical or solid mechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决电磁散射问题中传统数值模拟计算成本高的问题。
summary_zh.method: 使用改进的傅里叶神经算子作为代理求解器，实现梯度优化的逆向设计。
summary_zh.result: 在自由形态三维纳米光子逆向设计中展示了有效性和数据效率。
summary_zh.validation: 在电磁散射基准问题上进行数值验证，无实验或生物力学验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the high computational cost of traditional numerical simulations in electromagnetic scattering problems.
summary_en.method: Implements a modified Fourier neural operator as a surrogate solver for gradient-based inverse design of free-form 3D nanophotonic structures.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates improved data efficiency and successful inverse design in fully three-dimensional electromagnetic scattering scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Validated numerically on electromagnetic scattering benchmarks without experimental or biomechanical testing.

papers.title: A Comparison of the Microstructure, Mechanical Properties, and Corrosion Resistance of the K213 Superalloy after Conventional Casting and Selective Laser Melting
papers.abstract: K213 superalloy was fabricated by conventional casting and selective laser melting (SLM). The microstructures of the two samples were examined, and the mechanical properties and corrosion resistance of these two kinds of K213 alloy were comparatively studied. The results show that segregation of Ti occurs at the grain boundaries of the as-cast alloy, resulting in the formation of MC carbide. Many microcracks were formed in the SLM sample. Premature fracture of the as-cast alloy is caused by the precipitation of the harmful phase (Ti, Mo, Nb)C (MC). The MC carbides and microcracks in the as-cast and SLM alloys, respectively, induce tensile fracture. In comparison, the strength of the SLM sample is greater, while the elongation of the as-cast sample is greater. The oxidation resistance of the SLM sample is better at a high temperature of 800 °C. This is due to the relatively uniform composition and microstructure of the SLM alloy. However, the corrosion rate of the SLM alloy is accelerated during the electrochemical immersion corrosion process due to the existence of microcracks.

summary_zh.method: 对两种样品进行微观表征、拉伸测试和腐蚀实验。

summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和腐蚀实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the microstructure, mechanical properties, and corrosion resistance of K213 superalloy fabricated by conventional casting and selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Microstructural characterization, tensile testing, and electrochemical corrosion experiments were performed on both as-cast and SLM samples.
summary_en.result: SLM samples exhibited higher strength but contained microcracks, while as-cast samples had higher elongation; corrosion resistance varied due to microstructural differences.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via tensile testing and corrosion rate measurement.

papers.title: Study of the processing conditions for stainless steel additive manufacturing using femtosecond laser
papers.abstract: The use of ultrashort-pulsed (USP) lasers in Additive Manufacturing (AM) enables the processing of different materials and has the potential to reduce the sizes and shapes manufactured with this technology. This work confirms that USP lasers are a viable alternative for Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) when higher precision is required to manufacture certain critical parts. Promising results were obtained using tailored and own-produced stainless steel powder particles, manufacturing consistent square layers with a series of optimized processing parameters. The critical role of processing parameters is confirmed when using this type of lasers, as a slight deviation of any of them results in an absence of melting. For the first time, melting has been achieved at low pulse repetition (500 kHz) and using low average laser power values (0.5–1 W), by generating heat accumulation at reduced scanning speeds. This opens up the possibility of further reducing the minimum size of parts when using USP lasers for AM.

summary_zh.validation: 通过制造一致的正方形层验证参数有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the feasibility of using ultrafast femtosecond lasers for additive manufacturing of stainless steel with high precision.
summary_en.method: Laser powder bed fusion experiments were conducted using custom stainless steel powder with optimized processing parameters at low pulse repetition rate and low average power.
summary_en.result: Melting was achieved at 500 kHz and 0.5-1 W, demonstrating potential for miniaturization in additive manufacturing.
summary_en.validation: Consistent square layers were fabricated to confirm the effectiveness of the processing parameters.

papers.title: Effect of Hydroxyapatite/β-Tricalcium Phosphate on Osseointegration after Implantation into Mouse Maxilla.
papers.abstract: In our previous study we established an animal model for immediately placed implants using mice and clarified that there were no significant differences in the chronological healing process at the bone-implant interface between immediately and delayed placed implants blasted with hydroxyapatite (HA)/β-tricalcium phosphate (β-TCP) (ratio 1:4). This study aimed to analyze the effects of HA/β-TCP on osseointegration at the bone-implant interface after immediately placed implants in the maxillae of 4-week-old mice. Right maxillary first molars were extracted and cavities were prepared with a drill and titanium implants, blasted with or without HA/β-TCP, were placed. The fixation was followed-up at 1, 5, 7, 14, and 28 days after implantation, and the decalcified samples were embedded in paraffin and prepared sections were processed for immunohistochemistry using anti-osteopontin (OPN) and Ki67 antibodies, and tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase histochemistry. The undecalcified sample elements were quantitatively analyzed by an electron probe microanalyzer. Bone formation occurred on the preexisting bone surface (indirect osteogenesis) and on the implant surface (direct osteogenesis), indicating that osseointegration was achieved until 4 weeks post-operation in both of the groups. In the non-blasted group, the OPN immunoreactivity at the bone-implant interface was significantly decreased compared with the blasted group at week 2 and 4, as well as the rate of direct osteogenesis at week 4. These results suggest that the lack of HA/β-TCP on the implant surface affects the OPN immunoreactivity on the bone-implant interface, resulting in decreased direct osteogenesis following immediately placed titanium implants.

summary_zh.method: 建立小鼠颌骨即刻植入模型，进行免疫组化和元素分析。

summary_zh.validation: 动物实验，组织学和免疫组化学验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of HA/β-TCP coating on osseointegration in immediately placed implants in mouse maxilla.
summary_en.method: Used a mouse maxilla implantation model with blasted vs non-blasted titanium implants, followed by immunohistochemistry and EPMA analysis.
summary_en.result: Non-blasted implants showed significantly lower OPN immunoreactivity and direct osteogenesis rate at weeks 2 and 4.
summary_en.validation: Animal model with histological and immunohistochemical analysis.
